name: lance_encoding::encodings::logical::primitive::blob::<BlobPageScheduler as StructuralPageScheduler>::schedule_ranges
behavior: schedule_ranges sums unchecked end-start, requires descriptor Options via expect_ok, reserves request/LoadedBlob vectors using summed count as usize, and iterates caller ranges/order. First row in shard plus page row_number supplies priority. Arrow value(row as usize) assumes in-bounds and ignores null validity; unsorted/duplicate selections are not locally rejected. Zero-size descriptor decodes rep/def from position; def0 becomes prefilled Bytes::new and schedules no I/O, including rep!=0. Nonzero size ignores packed levels, creates0/0 placeholder and queues position..position+size with unchecked addition. bytes_so_far also adds unchecked. No EOF, overlap, range or payload-length validation. After each row, flush shard when accumulated nonempty payload sizes >=32MiB, taking vectors, preserving first-row priority and resetting counter. One large blob can exceed target; null/empty rows consume no byte budget and can accumulate without a row bound. Flush final nonempty descriptor vector, even with zero read ranges. Empty selection emits no tasks after requiring cache.

name: lance_encoding::encodings::logical::blob::<BlobStructuralEncoder as FieldEncoder>::maybe_encode
behavior: maybe_encode first appends array validity/no-null to supplied RepDefBuilder, then requires LargeBinary/i64 offsets (InvalidInput for other arrays), serializes levels and derives meanings. Existing builder assertions can happen before type rejection. Direct Binary/i32 input is not cast here, despite broader factory type predicate. If current meanings differ from cached meanings, flush buffered descriptor pages and wrap them with old meanings before replacing cache with new meanings. Flush failure returns before replacement; after success later failures can still leave state/external-buffer side effects. This prevents mixing all-valid and nullable arrays under one page interpretation. For each binary row: null requires definition buffer and stores (def<<16)+rep (if any) in position with size0, debug-asserting nonzero; empty valid stores0/0; other valid value copies bytes into Arrow Buffer/LanceBuffer and reserves out-of-line position, storing byte length. Nonnull values do not retain repetition level here. Level indexing assumes serialized positions correspond to binary rows; arbitrary nested correctness is not established by this loop alone. Construct nonnull two-child descriptor StructArray with no parent null bitmap, delegate maybe_encode with fresh empty RepDefBuilder and original row_number/num_rows, wrap resulting pages with outer meanings and append any prior flush tasks. Descriptor/data count and supplied row metadata consistency is delegated. Failure does not roll back buffers already added.

name: lance_encoding::encodings::logical::blob::<BlobV2StructuralEncoder as FieldEncoder>::maybe_encode
behavior: V2 maybe_encode requires StructArray then BlobV2Layout::Prepared, otherwise InvalidInput with actual dtype or classified/unrecognized layout. Classifier is called twice on rejection. This verifies six-field prepared schema shape, not row-level required values or kind-specific consistency. Logical and already-descriptor arrays are rejected. Read kind UInt8,data LargeBinary,uri Utf8,blob_id UInt32,blob_size UInt64,position UInt64 by name, with contextual missing-field errors then infallible typed casts. Shape classification normally proves types/names; direct row null/value requirements remain unchecked. Allocate five output builders by row count, URI capacity row_count*16 unchecked. Parent-null OR kind-null row emits valid placeholder child values Inline/0/0/0/empty URI; output later preserves only parent null bitmap, so a null kind under valid parent becomes a valid empty-looking inline descriptor. Dedicated emits kind,position0,raw blob_size/blob_id and empty URI, ignoring those child validities. External copies URI even if its validity is null, defaults missing position/size/base-id child values to0, otherwise copies them. Packed directly copies position/blob_size/blob_id without checking their validity and emits empty URI. No URI validation, sidecar existence, positive size/ID, offset bounds or checked range arithmetic here. Unknown nonnull kind fails BlobKind::try_from. Inline directly reads data even if child null, copies bytes to external-buffer collector even when empty, stores reserved position/length and id0/empty URI. Append all output children as nonnull values. Earlier rows can already have appended external buffers when a later unknown kind fails. No local rollback. Finish builders and create five-field descriptor StructArray with cloned original parent nulls only; pass original repdef,row metadata and collector to descriptor encoder. No BlobLayout wrapper or original-binary sentinel scheme. V2 null structure is ordinary Arrow parent validity.
